column3: Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017

(iii)
a ruling published under section 111 that is
in force;
the  application  relates  to  a  question  that  is  the
subject of a tax audit in relation to the applicant or
an objection lodged by the applicant;
the application is frivolous or vexatious;
the transaction to which the application relates has
not  been  carried  out  and  there  are  reasonable
grounds to believe that the transaction will not be
carried out;
the applicant has not provided the tax official with
sufficient information to make a private ruling;
in  the  opinion  of  the  Commissioner-General,  it
would  be  unreasonable  to  comply  with  the
application, having regard to the resources needed
to comply with the application and any other matters
the tax officer considers relevant; or
the making of the ruling involves the application
of a tax avoidance provision.
